title: Your combination: Sunday, Week, Listen
question: Bulletin as home, the week as the calendar, Listen for sermons, all in the bulletin's look. One choice left: should Listen stay dark like its sketch, or go light like the rest?

options.label: All light, bulletin look
options.thesis: Every tab shares the bulletin's navy masthead, white page and orange section tabs; Listen puts the latest sermon in its masthead.
options.viewport: Tabs: Sunday (the bulletin), Week (day rail and agenda), Listen (shown), More. Listen: masthead with the latest sermon and Listen / Watch, then Latest, Series, Speakers.
options.risk: Calmer and more consistent; listening feels less like an occasion.

options.label: Listen stays dark
options.thesis: Sunday and Week keep the bulletin's light look; Listen switches to a dark theatre so artwork and video lead.
options.viewport: Same four tabs. Listen: dark page, a large latest-service player, a keep-listening row with progress, series shelves.
options.risk: Two looks in one app; the switch on the Listen tab must feel deliberate, not like a bug.
